# **18  Market Area Analysis for Retail and Service Locations using Huff model**

## **18.1 Getting Started**

```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, MCI, tmap, ggstatsplot)
```

## **18.2 Importing Data**

### **18.2.1 Importing geospatial data**

```{r}
stores <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "STORES_TC")
```

```{r}
town <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "TOWN_TC")
```

```{r}
village <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "VILLAGE_TC")
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(town) +
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(village) +
  tm_polygons() + 
tm_shape(stores) +
  tm_dots()
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")
```

### **18.2.2 Importing aspatial data**

```{r}
pop2019 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/pop2019.csv")
```

```{r}
store_sales <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Store_sales_data.csv")
```

```{r}
summary(store_sales)
```

## **18.3 Data Preparation**

### **18.3.1 Aggregating store sales**

```{r}
store_sales_aggre <- store_sales %>%
  group_by(`Store Code`) %>%
  summarise(
    "Total_Bill" = sum(Bills, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Total_Sales" = sum(Amount, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### **18.3.2 Relational join**

```{r}
stores <- stores %>%
  left_join(store_sales_aggre,
            by = join_by(
              Store_CD == `Store Code`)) %>%
  mutate(Store_size = 100)
```

```{r}
summary(stores)
```

### **18.3.3 Tidying pop2019 data.frame**

```{r}
glimpse(pop2019)
```

```{r}
glimpse(village)
```

```{r}
pop2019 <- pop2019 %>%
  mutate(V_ID = str_remove_all(
    V_ID, "-"))
```

```{r}
village <- village %>%
  left_join(pop2019,
            by = join_by(
              VILLCODE == V_ID))
```

### **18.3.4 Check for missing or zero values**

```{r}
summary(village)
```

```{r}
village <- village %>%
  filter(!is.na(P_CNT)) 
```

```{r}
any(is.na(village$H_CNT))
```

```{r}
any(is.na(village$P_CNT))
```

```{r}
any(is.na(village$M_CNT))
```

```{r}
any(is.na(village$F_CNT))
```

## **18.4 Computing Distance Matrix**

```{r}
village_center <- st_point_on_surface(village)
distmat <- st_distance(village_center, stores) 
```

```{r}
rownames(distmat) <- village$`VILLCODE`
colnames(distmat) <- stores$`Store_CD`

distmat_long <- distmat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "VILLCODE") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -VILLCODE,
    names_to = "Store_CD",
    values_to = "distance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(distance = as.numeric(distance)) 
```

## **18.5 Preparing Interaction Matrix**

```{r}
interaction_matrix <- distmat_long %>%
  left_join(
    stores %>% 
      st_drop_geometry() %>% 
      select(Store_CD, Store_size),
    by = "Store_CD") %>%
  relocate(
    distance, .after = last_col())
```

```{r}
summary(interaction_matrix)
```

## **18.6 Computing Huff model**

```{r}
huff_share <- huff.shares(
  interaction_matrix, "VILLCODE", "Store_CD", 
  "Store_size", "distance")
```

### **18.6.1 Trade area analysis for a single store**

```{r}
market_share <- huff_share %>%
  filter(Store_CD == "BT")
```

```{r}
Trade_area <- village %>%
  left_join(market_share)
```

```{r}
selected_store <- stores %>%
  filter(Store_CD == "BT")
```

```{r}
tm_shape(Trade_area) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "p_ij",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", 
                n = 10,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Patronage Probability")) +
  tm_shape(selected_store) +
    tm_dots(size = 0.3,
            fill = "red",
            col = "black") +
  tm_title("Distribution of Patronage Probability of Store BT by village") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha =0.2) 
```

### **18.6.2 Store sales analysis**

```{r}
huff_share_pp <- huff_share %>%
  left_join(village %>% 
      st_drop_geometry() %>% 
      select(VILLCODE, P_CNT),
    by = "VILLCODE") %>%
  relocate(
    distance, .after = last_col())
```

```{r}
huff_total <- shares.total(
  huff_share_pp, "VILLCODE", "Store_CD",
  "p_ij", "P_CNT")
```

```{r}
store_sales_est <- stores %>%
  left_join(huff_total,
            by = join_by(
              "Store_CD" == "suppliers_single"))
```

```{r}
store_sales_nongeom <- store_sales_est %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

ggscatterstats(
  store_sales_nongeom,
  x = sum_E_j,
  y = Total_Sales)
```

```{r}
huff_share_wider <- huff_share %>%
  select(VILLCODE, Store_CD, p_ij) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Store_CD, 
                values_from = p_ij)
```

# What I Learned

This exercise used the Huff model, via the MCI package, to delineate the trade areas of fast-food stores in Taichung City. I learned that the model estimates the probability a consumer patronises a store from its attractiveness and its distance relative to competitors, so most of the effort goes into preparing the distance matrix and the interaction matrix rather than the modelling itself. Mapping the resulting market shares showed that trade areas depend on relative attractiveness in a competitive landscape, not proximity alone, which is what makes the Huff model useful for site selection.
